response.overview: Azura has spent years of her life as the perfect wife to Adli, a wealthy but selfish husband whose decision to remarry shakes the life she has built. When Nikita, a young woman who is bold and harbors a secretive past, enters their home, competition and jealousy begin to ignite. However, when both of them face Adli's manipulative behavior and cruelty, an unexpected bond begins to form. When a violent confrontation costs Adli his life, Azura and Nikita are bound by a dangerous secret. As the police investigation draws closer to the truth and old secrets begin to unravel, they must determine how far they are willing to go to protect each other.
response.title: Madu atau Racun
